precondition: Reach the existing division arm after original a.valid/b.valid, absolute-lower and ratio admission and the exact +1 denominator identity. Guard additionally requires RTExact(a,0), bounded nonzero b.hi. Unsupported cases use the entire original sequence.
proof: RPDivideSeed(0,b.hi) is canonical +0. Each product b*q returns canonical zero through the original exact-zero multiplication rule; each residual has zero center/radius, so its magnitude and ratio are zero. Every correction seed and updated q are canonical +0. The final residual ratio is zero because both admitted lower and abs(b.hi) are positive and bounded. RTPack of the zero center/radius returns exactly [0,0,0,0,1]. This is also the new RTConstant(0). The extra high-word guard preserves the original refusal for malformed tuples whose lower computation can be positive despite a zero/nonfinite high word.
identity_boundary: The existing exact +1 denominator return precedes this guard, preserving all incoming zero signs, radius-zero sign and nonzero validity flag word on that identity path.
